says: Checks in both versions: `pnpm lint` does not run `next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/ratchet.ts`, the check behind CI's `lists only shrink` step, so a branch that edits a row of `next-ledger.json` passes every local check and goes red only in CI. Three agents in a row on ticket 979 pushed that red without seeing it.
proof: CI's `check` job on pull request 1248 printed `{"_tag":"stuck","file":"next-ledger.json","reason":"row_added",...}` and `1 row(s) added against 706bac37202e58433a29506fb4f315b8f0a7e389`. On the same head, 2c9c4f429, `node next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/ratchet.ts --base "$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)"` prints the same line and exits 1. The `lint` script in package.json line 11 runs `oxlint-plugins/lint.ts`, which reads the working tree's `next-ledger.json` and finds the edited row matching the edited line, so it passes; nothing in that script compares the list with main's, which is what ratchet.ts does from `--base` to the committed HEAD.
cost: Three fix and recheck rounds of ticket 979 pushed on a red check, then one more agent round to find it; each round is a full agent run, plus a CI run per push.
